source_signature.notes: Batch 4F skill 4/5. Scope Operator-derived. The SOLVE skill for dismembered frames and machines: frame_machine_fbd (35c52289) drew the member FBDs with two-component pin forces and Newton's-third-law pairing; this skill SOLVES those coupled members for the unknowns. Synthesis of three signed parents: frame_machine_fbd (the FBDs and third-law pairs being solved), rigid_body_equilibrium_2d (the equilibrium equations and how to solve them), two_force_member_identification (which members give one unknown, not two). The essence beyond single-body equilibrium is the MULTI-body coupling: a shared internal pin passes an unknown from one member to the next. Worked example Operator-re-derived: Ax=-250, Ay=300, Bx=-250, By=-300 N, with the internal-pin pair equal-and-opposite and the assembled-frame equilibrium check closing to zero. FOUR-signal mapping, all content-earned: solution_sequencing_error at step 3, axis_confusion at step 4, sign_or_placement_error at step 5, unclassified at step 6. solution_sequencing_error is the FIFTH canonical signal, adopted this batch under Architect Ruling A after this skill exposed a member-sequencing error class - solving a member before its shared-pin unknown is available - that none of the original four could name without a silent force-fit. It is EVIDENCE-GATED per the ruling's mandatory classification constraint: emitted only on direct evidence of solve order (a structured intermediate, an explicitly chosen first body, an ordered response, or a family distractor representing premature member solving), never inferred from a wrong final number alone; absent solve-order evidence it falls to unclassified. The taxonomy was adopted atomically across all four enforcement surfaces (schema both enums, policy module, backend loader, Alpha10 test rename) at commit 35c2ddb7, after a pre-existing content defect - solve_particle_equil_2d's unknown_direction_not_modeled annotation mapping to axis_confusion instead of the policy's unclassified - was corrected first (commit 3cb5cdbc) so the full regression suite was green before the taxonomy landed. axis_confusion and sign_or_placement_error are genuinely earned here (the skill resolves forces into components and signs them across the third-law pin), the same as frame_machine_fbd and unlike the count-and-classify skills. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Hard stops verified absent: this skill does not re-teach FBD drawing (frame_machine_fbd's job), run method of joints/sections, apply a truss determinacy count, or go 3D. The single-source import refactor (backend loader and Alpha10 test each redefine the canonical set locally instead of importing the policy module) is deferred to the Batch 4F close report as debt.
